summary: Backend testing of Failed Payment Tracker complete. All 21 pytest tests passed (100% backend success). Covered: root endpoint, payment CRUD (create with full fields, get by id, list, update with persistence verification, delete + 404 verify), filters (status=Pending), search across merchant/txn_id/bank_name, stats aggregation, stats recalculation after status update, screenshot upload (PNG accepted, txt rejected with 400), screenshot download with correct content-type and bytes, linking screenshot_path to payments, 404 paths. Emergent object storage integration verified end-to-end via upload+download roundtrip.
critical_code_review_comments: Route ordering in server.py is correct: /payments/stats is declared before /payments/{payment_id}, so FastAPI matches stats correctly. Good.
init_storage() uses a global storage_key cache, which works but is not thread-safe; acceptable for current scale.

upload_screenshot reads entire file into memory before size check (data = await file.read()); a streaming check or UploadFile.size check pre-read would be safer against abuse, though enforced at 10MB max.
payment_date stored as string (YYYY-MM-DD) per requirement; list endpoint sorts by string lexicographically which works for ISO dates. No issue.
No pagination on GET /payments (limit 1000 hardcoded). Acceptable for MVP but document in PRD.
CORS allow_origins set to '*' with allow_credentials=True - this combination is permissive and would be rejected by some browsers when credentials=true. Consider restricting in production.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_ prefixed payments and one PNG screenshot via Emergent object storage. Cleanup fixture deletes created payment ids at module teardown. One screenshot remains in storage (no delete endpoint exposed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully passing. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_payments.py is reusable as regression suite (21 tests, ~2s runtime). Uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from env. For future frontend testing, the backend is verified stable - focus on UI flows: dashboard stats display, filter/search inputs, CSV export, screenshot upload via form, and screenshot preview rendering.
